title: leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real
abstract:
PACE: A systematic approach for sim-to-real transfer of legged robots, identifying actuator and joint dynamics with standard joint encoders.

# ⚙️ PACE — Sim-to-Real Transfer for Legged Robots PACE is a framework for **sim-to-real transfer of diverse robotic systems**, combining data-driven system identification with evolutionary optimization. It enables accurate actuator modeling and robust adaptation between simulation to reality by explicitly learning physically meaningful dynamics parameters. --- ## 🤖🐾 What is PACE? PACE (Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution) bridges the gap between simulation and real hardware by: * Estimating actuator and joint dynamics directly from measured data * Using CMA-ES for parameter optimization * Applying learned parameters to improve sim-to-real locomotion performance * Supporting multiple robot platforms and actuator types It is designed to integrate seamlessly with **NVIDIA Isaac Lab** and follows its task and environment conventions. --- ## 📦 Installation ### 1. Install Isaac Lab Follow the official Isaac Lab installation guide: [https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html) We recommend using the **conda** or **uv** installation method, as this simplifies running Python scripts from the terminal and managing dependencies. ### 2. Clone this repository Clone or copy this project separately from the Isaac Lab installation (i.e. outside the `IsaacLab` directory): ### 3. Install PACE in editable mode Using a Python interpreter that has Isaac Lab installed: ### ⚠️ Isaac Sim version compatibility PACE is developed and tested against **Isaac Sim 5.0 / Isaac Lab (latest)**. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：PACE（Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution）先用标准关节编码器采集激励轨迹数据，再以 CMA-ES 进化优化拟合执行器与关节动力学参数（数据驱动的系统辨识），并把学到的参数注入基于 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 的仿真环境中训练腿足运动策略，实现跨平台、跨执行器类型的 sim-to-real 迁移。


# 一、动机

> 腿足机器人从仿真迁移到真机时常因执行器与关节动力学建模不准而出现性能落差（reality gap），而传统系统辨识往往依赖额外传感器或难以刻画非线性摩擦/延迟等效应。PACE 旨在仅用标准关节编码器即可辨识出物理可解释的动力学参数，从而提升 sim-to-real 的鲁棒性。


# 二、方法

> PACE（Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution）先用标准关节编码器采集激励轨迹数据，再以 CMA-ES 进化优化拟合执行器与关节动力学参数（数据驱动的系统辨识），并把学到的参数注入基于 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 的仿真环境中训练腿足运动策略，实现跨平台、跨执行器类型的 sim-to-real 迁移。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 摘要与仓库文档未给出量化指标，主要结论为：1）仅用标准关节编码器即可完成执行器与关节动力学辨识，无需额外传感硬件；2）参数拟合由 CMA-ES 完成，并以可编辑模式集成进 Isaac Lab（开发与测试环境为 Isaac Sim 5.0 / 最新 Isaac Lab，旧版本如 4.5 会出现警告）；3）框架支持多种机器人平台与执行器类型，用于改善腿足运动在真机上的表现。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：缺少公开的定量对比（如迁移成功率、跟踪误差、真机速度提升等），实际效果高度依赖激励数据的覆盖度与质量，且强绑定 Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim 5.0 生态，复现成本较高。启发：把「执行器级系统辨识」与「策略级进化/RL 训练」解耦是一条低硬件成本的 sim-to-real 路线，可用标准编码器数据迁移到自研平台，但需要自行设计激励轨迹与验证指标。
